reason: Paying nothing until I'm happy is the first offer that actually speaks to what happened to me last time, I'll give him that. But I've had three of these DMs this month, he's one man in Kuwait with no UK clients, and I'm not handing my business's website to someone I can't drive round to when it goes down on a Saturday.
objection: When something breaks or he just stops replying, he's thousands of miles away with nobody in the UK I can chase. The last designer left me stuck and I don't want to go through that again with someone even harder to reach.
would_change_my_mind: Speaking to a real UK business owner he's already built for and looked after for a few months, plus a written promise of how fast he answers when the site breaks.
